gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, with big entrances into each curve and lowercase that fills most of the letter height. Baloo Thambi 2 is the one for expressive display, deep-bellied and full of personality, while Noticia Text does its best work as a steady text serif.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-piazzolla: Baloo Thambi 2 has a deep midsection in its lowercase and distinct gaps in c, e and s, which gives it plenty of character. It leads with expression, and Piazzolla follows as a refined text serif whose small letters nearly match its capitals.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-pridi: Round, chunky and full of character. Baloo Thambi 2 does the expressive work up front, and Pridi brings the refinement, with generous space where its curves meet the stem and small letters that stand almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-scope-one:
Baloo Thambi 2 carries a deep, full midsection in its lowercase.

Scope One sits beneath it as a classic serif, with stubby ascenders and descenders around a big x-height, and its counters spill out into the space around them.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-gf-slabo-13px: Bookish and dignified, Slabo 13px keeps large open counters in its tall a, e and s, with clear openings in every rounded letter. And Baloo Thambi 2 above it adds a deep-bodied, expressive voice, so a long page of this text serif feels inviting.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-crimson-pro: Chunky, stencil-cut and cheerfully bold. Balsamiq Sans holds one constant line width with no pinched curves, and Crimson Pro brings a restrained thick-thin cadence like a worn wooden stamp in a classic serif.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-neco: Neco reads authoritative and dignified, its strokes swelling by measured degrees from hairline to stem so no letter pinches shut. Balsamiq Sans pushes back with an o whose sides and top are equally thick.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-recia: Recia is sharp and authoritative. Its modulation is light, visible mainly up close, like a lightly pressed brush, with openings that stay generous, while Balsamiq Sans lays down curves that never thin at the shoulders, so the two feel firm against soft.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-alegreya: Literary in feel, Alegreya runs a tempered contrast like a lightly flexed spring wire, with wide apertures that resist filling in. Against Balsamiq Sans, built like bent tubing of one gauge, it sets bent metal against bookish warmth.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-alegreya-sc: Balsamiq Sans lays its line down like a stencil-cut channel, with no tight or pinched curves anywhere. Alegreya SC, a classic serif, answers with slightly thinner tops on rounded letters and a wide-open s that never tightens.
